visualReview: All hurt frames show low-arm backward recoil, slump, recovery. Sword rows expose backswing and fully extended contact, distinct from block. Uniform source scaling used for all frames within each atlas.
remainingOutliers: Weaponless Zabuza source has darker waist cloth and broader torso than idle; no sword present.

swordScaleBasis: Rejected1.31 from poseheight because head/torso enlarged.1.02 chosen from visible face-height and torso-length comparison to idle; lower silhouette is expected from wide bent-knee stance.
